buildCommand: if [ ! -d flutter/bin ]; then FLUTTER_JSON=$(curl -sS https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/releases_linux.json) && FLUTTER_ARCHIVE=$(echo "$FLUTTER_JSON" | grep -o '"archive":"[^"]*stable[^"]*\.tar\.xz"' | head -1 | sed 's/"archive":"//;s/"//') && curl -sS "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/$FLUTTER_ARCHIVE" -o flutter.tar.xz && tar xf flutter.tar.xz && rm flutter.tar.xz; fi && export PATH="$PATH:`pwd`/flutter/bin" && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons
